作About

Made by hand, by one person.

How each box is cut, joined and tested, who's making them, and the testers who helped shape it.

四 Process

Built by one person, in small batches.

手作り

Handmade enclosure

I cut each box from solid hardwood, join it by hand without screws or nails, and finish it with oil.

電子

Real components

Good parts on one custom circuit board, with no loose wires. Every unit is burned in and self-tested before it ships.

少量

Small batches, by design

The first batch is 25 because that's how many I can build well by hand. After that, a bigger run goes to Kickstarter.

From v1 to v2

→

Next: everything on one custom board, with no loose wires at all.

What's inside

You'll only ever deal with four things: the screen, the top, the knob and one cable. The rest stays inside the box.

  1. The screen 4,096 lights, easy to read from across the room
  2. The top tap your phone on it to set up Wi-Fi or open hako's page
  3. The knob turn to change screens, press to refresh, hold for the menu
  4. One cable with an adapter made for your country
五 Maker

Made by Jared.

I'm a Japanese learner and YouTuber who's spent the last few years documenting AJATT-style immersion at @jareddesu. hako started because my desk needed something quieter than a phone and more present than a tab.

It's a solo project. Every unit will be assembled, tested, and shipped by me. If you have a question, you'll hear back from me directly.
